messages.author: bfa1e51adf59de20
messages.subject: yeast tetrad cross type
parts:
Hi,

I would like to estimate the recombination fraction from a yeast cross of S96 with YJM789.

Should i treat the data from 56 tetrads as 224 separate F2 inter-cross between two inbred lines? What cross type should i format my tetrad data to use with R-QTL?

Thanks,

John

I am trying to use the data from the Mancera 2008 paper to recreate this figure: http://www.nature.com/nature/journal/v454/n7203/fig_tab/nature07135_F2.html)

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] yeast tetrad cross type
parts:
I don't have any experience with tetrad analysis, and R/qtl doesn't offer anything special for it.

If you just want an estimate of the recombination fraction, then treating it like "single-spore" data is fine. But I'd want to look for software that takes the tetrads into proper account.

karl
